data.name: Indrajit
data.gender_notes: Indrajit is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit indra, 'Indra', + jit, 'conqueror' — 'conqueror of Indra'. Its root is Sanskrit indra + jit. Indrajit, son of Ravana in the Ramayana. Indrajit is a Sanskrit name meaning “Conqueror of Indra”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Indrajit expresses “Conqueror of Indra”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit indra, 'Indra', + jit, 'conqueror' — 'conqueror of Indra'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indrajit total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

vedic_reference.note: Indrajit is the name of Ravana's son in Hindu mythology who fought against Lord Rama in the great war.

historical_references.reference: Indrajit, son of Ravana in the Ramayana.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Indrajit?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Indrajit is 4 (ruling planet Rahu). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Indrajit?
faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for Indrajit. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Indrajit?
faq.a: Hessonite is the traditional association for Indrajit. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Indrajit?
faq.a: Grey, Blue are the traditional associations for Indrajit. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Indrajit?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indrajit total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Indrajit?
faq.a: The meaning of Indrajit carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Indrajit have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Indrajit is recorded as a hindu name meaning “Conqueror of Indra”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Indrajit?
faq.a: In English, Indrajit is rendered as “Conqueror of Indra”.

faq.q: Is Indrajit suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Indrajit is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.

faq.q: What is the full form of Indrajit?
faq.a: Indrajit is the full recorded form; any short forms are listed in the nicknames field.

faq.q: Which culture uses the name Indrajit?
faq.a: Indrajit is used in Sanskrit naming traditions.

faq.q: Does Indrajit have a positive meaning?
faq.a: Indrajit carries the meaning “Conqueror of Indra”.
